reason: Wikidata lists only Ciudad de la Paz, the planned capital. The government still sits in Malabo and most references give Malabo, so both count.
New Delhi sits inside Delhi and most people call the capital Delhi. Wikidata does not list it as an alias, so typed answers would reject it.
